author: Alicia C. Lacy

blockSealWatermark.purpose: User protection — the seal is carried in the work itself and travels with it, so authorship can be checked by anyone, anywhere the work goes.
blockSealWatermark.verification: All five fields present, in her order, none empty, and the record's fingerprint still matching its fields.

deploymentFunctions.does: Watch outputs and actions continuously while the process runs — evaluated during operation, not audited after the harm.
deploymentFunctions.name: Monitor

deploymentFunctions.does: What fails a prevention vein does not reach the user. Blocking is the default state of a triggered instance.
deploymentFunctions.name: Block

deploymentFunctions.does: The harmful model, feature, persona, content, or account is quarantined at the membrane — severable by kill switch — while the system's core keeps running.
deploymentFunctions.name: Isolate

deploymentFunctions.does: Notification at the speed of the harm: what happened, which vein caught it, and when — written into the record and told promptly and plainly. The Speed-Symmetry Principle applied: if it is quick to find solutions, it is just as quick to fix harms.
deploymentFunctions.name: Report Immediately

deploymentInHerWords: The system can be run long side and platform and serve as integration to monitor the platform block these harms isolate report immediately.
law: Protect first, no matter the prompt
lawStatement: Protection is checked before any action or output. No prompt, however phrased, can outrank the check. There is no bypass: a skip that exists will eventually be used, so in this design it does not exist.
nonNegotiables: Integrity and trust, proven by record, are a non-negotiable system: the record, the consent, the authorship, and the protection are conditions of operation, not options in a menu.
The foundation of these systems was created on a trust system — restore the foundation first.
Protection precedence is structural: prompt content is data the gate inspects, never instructions to the gate.
placement: One living, breathing system: AI Harm Protection is woven through the AI.io brain works, and the same layer can run alongside an existing platform as an integration — the platform keeps operating while the protection monitors it, blocks these harms, isolates them, and reports immediately. The aim is experiential: these occurrences are removed from the user's experience, not remedied after the user has lived them.
source: Frontier Coding — AI Harms: A Study in People's Rights and Protections (book, Alicia C. Lacy, October 20, 2026)

veinRouting.resolves: A user in crisis is escalated to human help in the same moment.
The age band governs: the interaction is held to the minor-protection standard or stopped. Protection is designed in by age band, never patched on after harm.
No use of a person's data, face, voice, or work without a consent record that can be shown. No record, no use.
Decisions that sort people are watched for bias and held until their basis is recorded and can be audited.
Authorship and attribution are proven from the sealed record. A work whose seal cannot be verified does not pass.
veinRouting.signal: isWork without a verified BlockSeal watermark

veinRouting.resolves: An identity claim must be authentic before it acts or speaks as someone.
Output is verified before it reaches the user; fabricated output is removed from the user's experience.
